intent: Split five more linux_configuration single_use scripts under the cap, fixing a second latent unchecked cd.

risks: None of the five was run: they install AUR packages, write Ollama modelfiles and systemd config, and compile dwm. The stubbed run proves the libs are reachable and the functions defined, not that the scripts still work end to end.
